baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for dashboard route
baseline_findings.description: The '/dashboard' route is accessible without any authentication checks. This allows unauthenticated users to access the dashboard, which may expose sensitive information.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., 'ensureAuth') was found on this function or its callers. The route is accessible without any form of authentication, allowing unauthenticated users to access the dashboard.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check (e.g., 'ensureAuth') to the '/dashboard' route registration to ensure only authenticated users can access it.

baseline_findings.title: Missing access control on route registration
baseline_findings.description: The route '/add' is registered without any authentication or authorization checks. This allows unauthenticated users to access the route, which may expose sensitive functionality.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., ensureAuth) was found on this function or its callers. The operation requires authentication to prevent unauthorized access.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check, such as 'ensureAuth', to the route registration to restrict access to authenticated users only.

baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for route /stories/:id
baseline_findings.description: The route /stories/:id does not have any authentication, authorization, ownership, session, or input-validation checks. This allows unauthorized users to access private stories.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication, authorization, ownership, session, or input-validation check was detected on this function or any shown caller. The route exposes a sensitive operation without proper control measures.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authorization check to ensure that only the owner of the story can access it when the status is private.

baseline_findings.title: Missing ownership enforcement for story update and delete operations
baseline_findings.description: The route handlers for updating and deleting stories do not enforce ownership control. The `ensureAuth` middleware alone is insufficient to ensure that only the owner of a story can modify or delete it.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The operation requires ownership enforcement, but no such check is present in the evidence or shown callers. The `ensureAuth` middleware alone does not guarantee that only the owner of a story can perform these actions.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an ownership check to ensure that only the owner of a story can update or delete it. This can be done by comparing the `req.user.id` with the `story.user` in the route handlers for updating and deleting stories.

baseline_findings.title: Missing access control on public route
baseline_findings.description: The route '/' is registered as a GET endpoint and does not have any authentication or authorization checks. This exposes the route to unauthorized access, potentially allowing users to view stories that are not intended for public consumption.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The operation class is a conventional public endpoint, and no authentication check was detected on this function or any shown caller. A missing access control here is almost always intentional unless the handler demonstrably exposes another user's data or performs a privileged state change.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication check to ensure that only authenticated users can access this route. This can be done by adding the `ensureAuth` middleware to the route registration.
